items.title: 偉訓部分資訊系統遭網路安全事件，已隔離受影響系統並啟動調查
items.summary: 上市電子零組件廠偉訓（3032）於8月30日晚間，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布資安重訊，表示已偵測到部分資訊系統遭受網路安全事件，在發現異常後立即啟動資安應變機制，隔離受影響的資訊系統並進行風險控管，同時委請外部專業資安廠商協助系統復原及事件調查。

items.title: Palo Alto Networks併購Console，擴充AI代理資安能力

items.title: 光電廠杭特遭網路攻擊
items.summary: 上櫃光電廠杭特（3297）在8月31日晚間於股市公開資訊觀測站發布資安重訊，公司資訊系統遭受網路攻擊，目前已啟動資訊安全防禦機制，並委請外部資安技術公司及專家協助處理。不過，此次攻擊的入侵途徑、遭影響的資訊系統，以及是否有資料遭到未授權存取或外洩，杭特目前並未在公告中進一步說明。

items.summary: 電腦及週邊設備商富驊企業（5465）於8月30日晚間，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布資安重訊指出，他們偵測到部分資訊系統遭網路攻擊的情況，在偵測到異常後立即啟動資安應變機制，迅速將受影響系統隔離，並採取風險控管措施，同時對全公司資訊系統進行盤點及持續監控，委託外部資安廠商協助系統復原、事件調查，以及相關強化作

items.title: fix(plugin-sdk): run lifecycle-less prepared channel turns
items.summary: fix(plugin-sdk): run lifecycle-less prepared channel turns ## What Problem This Solves Supported installed channel plugins built before `runDispatchLifecycle` can receive inbound messages but crash before dispatch after the OpenClaw host is updated. The host throws `runChannelInboundEvent prepared turns must declare runDispatchLifecycle when creating runDispatch` even when the caller has no top-level adoption lifecycle. Product path: SDK hardening through the published `openclaw/plugin-sdk/channel-inbound` entry point used by installed channel plugins. ## Why This Change Was Made The channel-turn lifecycle owner now validates prepared dispatch ownership only when the caller supplied a top-level adoption owner. Lifecycle-less turns continue through the existing canonical `runPreparedChannelTurn` path. Adoption-aware turns still reject missing or mismatched ownership, and dispatch-skip cleanup stays unchanged. The plugin-runtime test helper now follows the same contract. The regression reuses the existing prepared-dispatch test instead of adding a duplicate. ## User Impact Users can update the OpenClaw host without breaking inbound replies from supported older installed channel plugins. Current channel plugins keep the strict adoption and cleanup contract. ## Evidence - Baseline main `dfa8b7df9e6f58dd7baab29ee7e2e238c74580a8`: two distinct legacy-shaped inbound events through `createRuntimeChannel().inbound.run` both exited 1 before record or dispatch with the reported assertion. - Repaired head `bc04db2b63ed5831770dc4f79b77e8c34ddd3ffc`: distinct events through the same runtime boundary each recorded once, dispatched once, and returned a final reply result. - Regression proof: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugin-sdk/channel-inbound.test.ts` failed on exact main through the published package entry point for the intended assertion, then passed on the repaired head. - Sibling proof: the prepared lifecycle, plugin-runtime mock, custody, and finalization suites passed 43 tests. - Static proof: formatting, conflict-marker, max-lines, assertion-safety, SDK-surface, plugin-boundary, temporary-file, Oxlint, import-cycle, and diff checks passed. - Candidate CI found an added TypeScript suppression. The final fixture now models the compiled legacy object at runtime, and the suppression inventory passes without a new exception. - Exact-head Autoreview then required the regression at a shipped product boundary. The final test imports the published Plugin SDK entry point, while the internal lifecycle tests keep the owner and cleanup invariants strict. - Candidate CI then found one incomplete `FinalizedMsgContext` fixture. The final fixture includes the required command-authorization fact and keeps current Plugin SDK types strict. - Installed-plugin proof: the exact-head CI build loaded `@openclaw/matrix@2026.7.1`, received an encrypted inbound message on a disposable Matrix homeserver, sent the native reply, and the driver decrypted it end to end. [Proof and screenshot](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/135179#issuecomment-5503790357). Fixes #114020. Co-authored-by: fridaylans2000-art Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.title: fix(codex): stop interrupting active turns during quiet native work (…
items.summary: fix(codex): stop interrupting active turns during quiet native work (#134755) * fix(codex): stop interrupting active turns during quiet native work Let native Codex own turn liveness and completion. Replace inferred idle watches with elapsed execution and terminal-settlement deadlines, and carry exact active ownership into shared recovery and queue policy. Preserve partial output with visible non-replayable failures, and retire obsolete timeout settings through Doctor. Real native before/after proof reproduces the old 300-second interruption and verifies completion of the 320-second stream plus a subsequent turn. Focused regressions, build, canonical changed checks, and P0 Codex autoreview pass. Related: #99272. * fix(agents): unify deadline ownership and preserve timeout failures Give built-in attempts and tool-free finalizers fresh closure-bound deadline and cancellation controls. Preserve approval pauses and compaction grace, honor unlimited execution without a sentinel timer, and remove synthetic lane progress heartbeats. Capture diagnostic generation before question expiry so stale observations cannot abort resumed or replacement work. Record final timeout explanations at the terminal owner and carry them through command and channel settlement without replacing them with earlier tool errors or reporting success. This complements the native Codex lifecycle repair in #134755 and addresses the blind heartbeat in #122233. Prove retired Codex settings migrate at startup while retaining connection settings and the execution budget. Carry the upstream stdin test-type fix 01129d7bbe06ba05f1e4850d6b6a38c4f2a2c22b and use canonical fixture exports instead of redundant forwarding functions. Validation: 1,632 owner/sibling tests across 52 files; 237 native fixture cases rerun after cleanup; all 38 canonical changed-check commands; full runtime, SDK declaration and Control UI build; fresh P0 Codex autoreview. Live isolated Gateway/UI: 45,035ms execution timeout despite provider progress, actionable error details, and a successful subsequent user turn. No deployment, production-session resumption, or release. * fix(agents): settle Stop from authoritative lane cancellation Preserve killed session state and stopped partial output when parent cancellation revokes attempt callbacks first. Remove the redundant callback latch, classify run-owned direct aborts at the shared owner, and update dispatch/acquisition fixtures to exercise current controls. Proof: 277 focused tests across 16 files, canonical changed checks, and fresh scoped Codex P0 autoreview pass. The original real Gateway Stop assertion and isolated live before-capture reproduce the incorrect failed state. Follow-up to PR #134755. * test(agents): load lifecycle modules before timed cases Initialize the execution graph during collection after shared mocks register, before a case owns an active handle or one-shot mock. A timed-out cold import must not resume into the following cancellation case. Preserve assertions, restart-to-Stop ordering, and existing timeouts. Proof: 599 tests across 12 rebase-regression files pass from a fresh module cache, focused lint/format pass, and scoped Codex P0 autoreview is clean. Production runtime remains identical to the built and live-verified e20a4ee879ee0228f00ae36067297fb414c0413e. * test(codex): use managed lifecycle for stopped-thread resume
